name: IPN Hand
description: In this paper, we introduce a new benchmark dataset named IPN Hand with sufficient size, variety, and real-world elements able to train and evaluate deep neural networks. This dataset contains more than 4,000 gesture samples and 800,000 RGB frames from 50 distinct subjects. We design 13 different static and dynamic gestures focused on interaction with touchless screens. We especially consider the scenario when continuous gestures are performed without transition states, and when subjects perform natural movements with their hands as non-gesture actions. Gestures were collected from about 30 diverse scenes, with real-world variation in background and illumination. With our dataset, the performance of three 3D-CNN models is evaluated on the tasks of isolated and continuous real-time HGR. reputation: A useful but relatively specialized benchmark in hand-gesture recognition, especially for real-world continuous and isolated gesture settings.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; moderate dataset size with real-world variation, and results can depend strongly on modality choices and protocol details.
